description:
Adds the tests that observe the route the batch decoder takes under the committed coding envelope, under conservative selectors and without the lane capability.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A coding owner envelope with calibrated decode selectors is committed under `crates/gf2-coding/data/tuning-profiles/`. The LDPC batch decoder has a route reporter that returns the route a batch size takes without decoding, and tuning is installed once per process, so observation of an installed profile runs in a fresh process.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A fresh-process test installs the committed envelope and observes, through the route reporter, the route on each side of each selector value the envelope states.
- [hard] REQ-02: Without installation the reporter gives the single-frame route for each batch size, and with the lane capability absent the lane route reports the portable backend.
- [hard] REQ-03: A decode under the installed envelope equals the single-frame decoder's results on the shared suite's inputs.
- [hard] REQ-04: A test fails if a decode route threshold exists outside the selector family and its conservative definitions.
- [hard] REQ-05: A repository test decodes each committed coding envelope through the owner codec and checks its measurement provenance against the codec's harness schema.
title: Verify decoder dispatch under the committed profile
